name: GaugeChart
descriptionFull:
GaugeChart - Presentational gauge / speedometer chart.

Implementation note: the gauge is drawn by a pure-SVG internal implementation (see `./gauge-svg.tsx`), so the component is bundler- and runtime-agnostic and carries no third-party runtime dependency. The gauge packages on NPM are published CommonJS-only with a `module` field pointing at the same CJS file, which crashes under ESM bundlers that add no `__esModule ? .default : module` interop shim (Webpack 4, raw esbuild, some SSR setups) with React's "Element type is invalid" error

props.name: percent
props.description: Value between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.75 = 75%). Values outside the range are clamped

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Arc thickness as a fraction of the gauge radius (0–1)

props.name: nrOfLevels
props.description: Number of arc segments. Ignored when `arcsLength` is provided

props.name: arcsLength
props.description: Custom arc-segment proportions (auto-normalised), overriding `nrOfLevels`. e.g. `[0.7, 0.3]` for a progress-style gauge…
props.descriptionFull: Custom arc-segment proportions (auto-normalised), overriding `nrOfLevels`. e.g. `[0.7, 0.3]` for a progress-style gauge whose first arc is the fill

props.name: hideNeedle
props.description: Hide the needle + hub (e.g. for a progress-style gauge)

props.name: formatTextValue
props.description: Format the center label from the clamped fraction (0–1)

props.name: hideText
props.description: Hide the percentage text rendered inside the gauge

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id used for the gauge's accessibility labels

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in pixels or any CSS length (e.g. `'200px'` or `'50%'`)
